daily.headline: The Toowoomba repeater has been silent since 4:23 on Sunday morning, and the Lockyer stations behind it went with it: one path, not twenty faults.
Twenty-one stations behind the Hillcrest repeater went quiet — one shared path, not 21 faults — and four only because we stopped listening.

weekly.headline: Half the week’s trouble was at our end: 152.400 is no longer listened to, and 151.5375 was dark for two days. Five stations around Caboolture barely reach us.
A wet week in which our base station began hearing four times the stations — and the Hillcrest repeater, half its relays corrupted all week, faded at the end of it.
